adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the diff replaces creating a topic with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)`. In `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (new in this diff), it calls `open(url).read` directly before any URL validation. The only `^https?` check is in `TopicEmbed.import`, which runs *after* the fetch. From the diff alone, this means a malicious `t[:link]` could be passed to `Kernel#open`/open-uri without scheme/URI validation, enabling local file reads (non-HTTP paths) and potentially command execution via the `|cmd` form.
